name: colophon
description: The Colophon skill: a sigil that declares AI co-authorship in comments, tickets and messages.

plugins.name: colophon
plugins.description: Appends the sigil ※ to comments, tickets and messages the AI has substantially co-written, linking to a page that names the model, what it contributed, and whether a human posted it. Covers GitHub, Jira, Slack and Trello.
